description: This file defines the AzureStorageOperationOptions class and its validator, providing configuration options and validation logic for Azure Storage operations within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for setting up the TableServiceClient with various authentication methods, and validation routines to ensure proper configuration.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration options for Azure Storage operations, including setting up the TableServiceClient with various authentication methods and validation routines.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator
classes.description: A generic validator class for AzureStorageOperationOptions, ensuring the options are correctly configured.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Sets up the TableServiceClient using a connection string, URI, or callback, with obsolete overloads for different authentication methods.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the current configuration, ensuring the TableName is valid and that the CreateClient delegate is set.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Invokes the validation routine on the options instance.
